learning_outcomes.text: Know the definition of language, comprehend its place and importance in national life as a social institution, and recognize the connection between language-culture and language-thought.
Learn the place of the Turkish language among world languages, and recognize the richness and subtleties of Turkish.
Know the historical development of the Turkish language.
Know the current status of the Turkish language, its contemporary dialects, and areas of spread.
Comprehend the phonetic and structural features/rules of the Turkish language; gain proficiency in Turkish oral and written communication.
Gain awareness about language pollution/degradation issues, and know the factors that threaten or could threaten the existence of Turkish.

syllabus_topics: Definition, Origin and Characteristics of Language
Social Aspect of Language: Its Relation to Society, Culture-Nation, Thought, Emotion and Communication
Types of Language, Types of Language Analysis, Languages in Terms of Developed-Undeveloped Comparison
Languages of the World and Classification of Languages
Historical Periods of the Turkish Language: 1. Old Turkish
Historical Periods of the Turkish Language: 2. Middle Turkish
Historical Periods of the Turkish Language: 3. New Turkish
Current Status and Areas of Spread of the Turkish Language
“Simplification” in the Turkish Language; Current Problems of the Turkish Language
Main Phonetic Characteristics of the Turkish Language, Ways of Word Formation in Turkish
assessment_rules: The overall grade is determined by a midterm exam weighted at 40% and a final exam weighted at 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan but are conducted on dates specified in the academic calendar by the University Senate's decision.
